payout_quote: the state will match the first $600 that you contribute to your Quest529 account during 2026. You must contribute at least $100 during 2026 to be eligible.
steps: Open a Quest529 account at Quest529.com if you do not already have one.
Attach 2025 federal tax returns or IRS transcripts for all household members required to file.
Mail the application and documents so they are received by the Kansas State Treasurer's Office no later than December 1, 2026 (supporting documents within 14 days of application).
Contribute $100-$600 to the KIDS Contribution Account during calendar 2026.
The matching grant is deposited to the Match Account no later than January 31, 2027.
catches: Kansas residents only; 2025 household federal AGI must be above $0 and at or below 200% of the federal poverty level (e.g., $66,000 for a 4-person household).
Dollar-for-dollar on YOUR contributions: contribute $100, get $100; contribute $600, get $600; contribute $0, get $0.
Capped at 1,000 participants statewide (250 per congressional district), first-come, first-served - applying does not guarantee a slot.
Any withdrawal from the account during 2026 disqualifies that beneficiary for the 2026 match.
Rollovers from other 529 plans are not match-eligible.

Matching funds must be used for the beneficiary's qualified education expenses; a non-qualified withdrawal must be repaid to the State of Kansas and faces federal/state taxes plus possible federal penalties - consult a tax advisor.
biggest_catch: Income-capped (200% of the federal poverty level) and slot-capped (1,000 participants, first-come, first-served): the match is dollar-for-dollar on your own 2026 contributions only, and any withdrawal during 2026 kills eligibility.
eligibility: Quest529 account owner who is a Kansas resident, not a minor or someone else's tax dependent, with 2025 household federal AGI greater than $0 and at or below 200% of the federal poverty level.
timing: 2026 program year: application due December 1, 2026; qualifying contributions during calendar 2026; match deposited by January 31, 2027.
payout_value_note: Dollar-for-dollar match on own 2026 contributions of $100-$600.
numeric_basis: payout from official 2026 KIDS program description ($100-$600 match); time: paper application + gathering tax documents + account opening, est. 30-45 min active.
